code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    interior = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    interior = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    horizontal = [r for r in range(h) if interior not in grid[r]]
    nonhorizontal = [r for r in range(h) if r not in horizontal]
    vertical = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != interior for r in nonhorizontal)]
    line_color = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in nonhorizontal for c in vertical).most_common(1)[0][0]
    horizontal = [r for r in horizontal if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for c in vertical)]
    vertical = [c for c in vertical if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in horizontal)]
    out = [[interior for _ in range(len(vertical)-1)] for _ in range(len(horizontal)-1)]
    for i in range(len(horizontal)-1):
        for j in range(len(vertical)-1):
            corners = [grid[horizontal[i]][vertical[j]], grid[horizontal[i]][vertical[j+1]],
                       grid[horizontal[i+1]][vertical[j]], grid[horizontal[i+1]][vertical[j+1]]]
            if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 and corners[0] != line_color:
                out[i][j] = corners[0]
    return out
